title: hf-crosstalk: analysis code and data for reconstruction-kernel reproducibility of automated thoracic CT volumetry
description: Analysis code, result tables and specifications for the manuscript "Reproducibility of automated whole-heart and great-vessel volumetry across chest CT reconstruction kernels: an agent-executed same-acquisition study with executable checks". Includes the script that produces the primary results table, slice-position z-extent computation, reconstruction-parameter and coverage sensitivity analyses, six analytical modules with executable checks, a standalone agent-free reproduction script, and the agent execution record. See README_R1.md. Version v1.2.0-R1 adds the independent whole-heart model check (independent_heart_model/) and the revision checks with their dated plans (revision_checks/).
